All 15 runs completed the 300-second window and were marked valid.
Graph 4 retains real latency outliers and uses a logarithmic y-axis so the central distribution remains readable.
Seven repeated SnapshotUpdated callbacks were freshness-state changes, not new UDP messages; they are documented and excluded from latency/message application counts.
Graph 5 shows mean Unity FPS across three runs; the publication PNG includes ±1 SD error bars.
Graph 7 uses a logarithmic state-age axis to show both low-rate and high-rate distributions without hiding rare long stalls.
The received transport counter can be one packet above the scheduled sequence span because the two counters are sampled at Unity frame boundaries; applied counts use unique source sequences.
